results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE reputation > 100000;
SELECT AVG(view_count) AS avg_view_count FROM posts_questions;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS negative_answer_count FROM posts_answers WHERE score < 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_comments FROM comments;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tag_id) AS distinct_tags_used FROM post_tags;
SELECT MAX(score) AS highest_question_score FROM posts_questions;

SELECT t.tag_name, COUNT(*) AS usage_count
FROM tags t
JOIN post_tags pt ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
JOIN posts_questions q ON pt.post_id = q.post_id
WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
ORDER BY usage_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT u.user_id, u.display_name, SUM(a.score) AS total_answer_score
FROM users u
JOIN posts_answers a ON a.user_id = u.user_id
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.display_name
ORDER BY total_answer_score DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(comment_count) AS avg_comments
FROM (
    SELECT q.post_id, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS comment_count
    FROM posts_questions q
    JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.post_id = q.post_id
    JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
    LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.post_id = q.post_id
    WHERE t.tag_name = 'javascript'
    GROUP BY q.post_id
)

SELECT u.user_id, u.display_name, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS comment_count
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.display_name
ORDER BY comment_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.tag_name, COUNT(*) AS question_count
FROM posts_questions q
JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.post_id = q.post_id
JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
WHERE q.score >= 10
GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
ORDER BY question_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT t.tag_name, AVG(q.view_count) AS avg_view_count, COUNT(*) AS question_count
FROM tags t
JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id
JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
ORDER BY avg_view_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS question_count
FROM posts_questions q
JOIN users u ON q.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) = strftime('%Y', u.creation_date);

SELECT u.user_id, u.display_name, COUNT(*) AS accepted_answer_count
FROM posts_answers a
JOIN posts_questions q ON a.parent_id = q.post_id
JOIN post_tags pt ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
JOIN tags t ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id
JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE a.is_accepted = 1
  AND LOWER(t.tag_name) = 'javascript'
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.display_name
ORDER BY accepted_answer_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts_questions q WHERE q.user_id = u.user_id)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS answers_without_comments
FROM posts_answers a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.post_id = a.post_id
)

SELECT t.tag_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_questions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unanswered_questions,
       1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS no_accepted_share
FROM tags t
JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id
JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
ORDER BY no_accepted_share DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer_count
FROM posts_answers
WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM posts_questions WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_with_zero_badges FROM users WHERE badge_count = 0;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS question_count
FROM posts_questions
WHERE creation_date >= '2021-03-01' AND creation_date < '2021-04-01'

SELECT
  strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) AS year,
  AVG((julianday(fa.first_answer_date) - julianday(q.creation_date)) * 24.0) AS avg_hours_to_first_answer
FROM posts_questions q
JOIN (
  SELECT parent_id, MIN(creation_date) AS first_answer_date
  FROM posts_answers
  GROUP BY parent_id
) fa ON fa.parent_id = q.post_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) IN ('2020', '2021')
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', q.creation_date)
ORDER BY year;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT q.post_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts_questions), 2) AS percentage_answered_within_24h
FROM posts_questions q
JOIN posts_answers a ON a.parent_id = q.post_id
WHERE (julianday(a.creation_date) - julianday(q.creation_date)) <= 1
AND julianday(a.creation_date) >= julianday(q.creation_date);

SELECT strftime('%m', creation_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS question_count
FROM posts_questions
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY question_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT strftime('%Y', creation_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_accepted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS acceptance_rate_percent
FROM posts_answers
WHERE creation_date >= '2021-01-01' AND creation_date < '2022-01-01'

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY creation_date, post_id) AS rn
  FROM posts_answers
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 'first_answer' ELSE 'later_answers' END AS answer_type,
  AVG(score) AS avg_score,
  COUNT(*) AS answer_count
FROM ranked
GROUP BY CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 'first_answer' ELSE 'later_answers' END;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS fraction_accepted
FROM posts_questions q
WHERE q.post_id IN (
    SELECT pt.post_id
    FROM post_tags pt
    JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
    WHERE t.tag_name = 'python'
);

SELECT AVG(acceptance_rate) AS avg_acceptance_rate
FROM (
    SELECT user_id,
           AVG(CASE WHEN is_accepted = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS acceptance_rate
    FROM posts_answers
    WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
) AS user_rates;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(CAST(vote_type AS TEXT)) IN ('3', 'downmod', 'downvote', 'down') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS downvote_share_percent
FROM votes;

WITH yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y', creation_date) AS year,
         user_id,
         COUNT(*) AS answer_count
  FROM posts_answers
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y', creation_date), user_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT year, user_id, answer_count,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY answer_count DESC) AS rnk
  FROM yearly_counts
)
SELECT r.year, r.user_id, u.display_name, r.answer_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id
WHERE r.rnk = 1
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT tag_name, month, question_count
FROM (
    SELECT t.tag_name,
           strftime('%Y-%m', q.creation_date) AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS question_count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.tag_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, strftime('%Y-%m', q.creation_date) ASC) AS rn
    FROM tags t
    JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id
    JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
    WHERE t.tag_id IN (
        SELECT tag_id
        FROM (
            SELECT pt2.tag_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pt2.post_id) AS cnt
            FROM post_tags pt2
            GROUP BY pt2.tag_id
            ORDER BY cnt DESC
            LIMIT 5
        )
    )
    GROUP BY t.tag_id, strftime('%Y-%m', q.creation_date)
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY question_count DESC;

SELECT month,
       monthly_answers,
       SUM(monthly_answers) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_answers
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', creation_date) AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS monthly_answers
    FROM posts_answers
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', creation_date)
) AS m
ORDER BY month;

SELECT q.post_id, q.title, MAX(a.score) AS max_answer_score, MIN(a.score) AS min_answer_score, MAX(a.score) - MIN(a.score) AS score_gap
FROM posts_questions q
JOIN posts_answers a ON a.parent_id = q.post_id
GROUP BY q.post_id, q.title
HAVING COUNT(a.post_id) >= 2
ORDER BY score_gap DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.tag_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) = '2021' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2021,
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) = '2020' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_2020,
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) = '2021' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) = '2020' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS increase
FROM tags t
JOIN post_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id
JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) IN ('2020', '2021')
GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
ORDER BY increase DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT t.tag_name, COUNT(*) AS question_count
FROM post_tags pt
JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id
JOIN posts_questions q ON q.post_id = pt.post_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', q.creation_date) = '2022'
GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name
ORDER BY question_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DATE(creation_date) AS day, COUNT(*) AS question_count
FROM posts_questions
GROUP BY DATE(creation_date)
ORDER BY question_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.user_id, u.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT v.post_id) AS posts_voted_on
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = v.user_id
WHERE v.user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.display_name
ORDER BY posts_voted_on DESC
LIMIT 10;
